response.overview: Beast has lived a quiet life without knowing his real name or the truth about his family. But when a series of strange encounters leads him into the dangerous world of organized crime, his life takes an unexpected turn.  Drawn into a mission involving an injured crime boss, a kidnapped associate, and the boss's mother, Beast must make a decision that could cost him his life. Meanwhile, a young master of the powerful Hood Family ends up in the hospital, bringing his father into a growing conflict that threatens to change everything.  As rival interests collide and hidden connections begin to emerge, Beast finds himself caught between survival, loyalty, and the truth about his past. One decision may be the key to discovering the family he never knew—and the destiny he never chose.
response.tagline: The last choice may be his only chance to find he origin.
response.title: THE LAST CHOICE
